title: Insurance News conference launches with Shark Tank star and broking chiefs
full_text:
Insurance News conference launches with Shark Tank star and broking chiefs
Shark Tank entrepreneur Nick Bell and broking leaders from Marsh and Gallagher are among confirmed speakers for the Insurance News Outlook 2027 conference on March 11.
Early bird tickets for the full-day Sydney event, supported by gold sponsor AAMC, went on sale today.
The Outlook conference will return after a successful 2026 event
As insuranceNEWS.com.au has reported, Mr Bell aims to build a $200 million brokerage in the next four years, and will give attendees an outsider’s view of insurance, explaining why he has homed in on the sector and how he will approach the venture.
Marsh Risk Pacific president Damian Schinck and Gallagher Australia CEO Alex Lumby will give their assessments of the major challenges for the year ahead, and Arch Insurance Australia Managing Director Dominic Brannigan also joins our CEO panel.
Outlook will once again feature exclusive insights from market research compiled by event partner Finity, and each attendee will benefit from first access to a printed copy of the Insurance News/Finity INFORM report.
INFORM tracks the latest market trends across all major lines, plus industry pressures and emerging opportunities – revealing implications for pricing, capacity and appetite.
Other topics addressed by speakers and panels are expected to include geopolitical forces and emerging technological risks, with in-depth sessions on motor, strata and rural insurance.
The event will be at Doltone House Darling Island Wharf in Pyrmont, and attendees are entitled to eight ANZIIF CIP points and six NIBA CPD points.
